title: NEON lake zooplankton metabarcoding, RELEASE-2026: detection of 492 names (COI reads, two primer sets) per field sample at 7 NEON lakes, 2018-2022
creator: NEON (National Ecological Observatory Network)
citation: NEON (National Ecological Observatory Network). Zooplankton metabarcoding (DP1.20221.001), RELEASE-2026. https://doi.org/10.48443/bgvz-a687. Dataset accessed from https://data.neonscience.org/data-products/DP1.20221.001/RELEASE-2026 on 2026-11-12
abstract: NEON's lake zooplankton metabarcoding: in the midsummer bout each year, three lake zooplankton samples (vertical tow net in water deeper than 4 m, Schindler-Patalas trap elsewhere) are taken on one day beside the morphological samples, homogenised, and their DNA extracted and amplified with two COI primer sets (BE and F230); the laboratory (Jonah Ventures to 2021, Laragen in 2022) sequences the amplicons, denoises them into exact sequence variants, and assigns each variant a name by BLAST consensus against a BOLD COI reference. y = 1 when a name has reads in a sample for a primer set (any variant the laboratory reported, NEON's reporting threshold), else 0; y_raw is the read count, which is not abundance. One occasion per sample x primer set; sequencing depth (obs_reads_total, obs_reads_filtered), the number of variants and the best percent match ride on each row. The names surveyed for at a site are every name assigned there in any sample (median 106 of 492; __survey_taxa). Coordinates are coarsened to the 0.1-degree cell because IUCN-threatened names are in the table; the _exact sibling has the other names at NEON's coordinates.
samplingProtocol: Three zooplankton DNA samples per lake on one day in the midsummer bout, near the buoy and two littoral sensor sets (NEON AOS zooplankton protocol NEON.DOC.001194); bulk DNA extraction, PCR with the COI primer sets BE and F230, Illumina MiSeq sequencing, DADA2 exact sequence variants, BLAST consensus naming against BOLD (NEON user guide NEON_INV_ZOO_DNA_userGuide_vG and laboratory SOPs)
surveyEvidenceNote: A survey is an extract x primer set with rows in zoo_metabarcodeTaxonomy (the laboratory's bioinformatics output for it), from a field sample in zoo_fieldData with samplingImpractical blank and a sequencing record NEON marks Pass. A 0 arises where such a survey reported no sequence variant assigned to a name of the site's pool. The pool is derived from detections (ruling 19; metabarcoding ruling of 2026-11-13): every name the laboratory assigned at the site in any sample by either primer set (__survey_taxa), not a list NEON deposited.
closureNote: occasion = field sample x primer set within one bout (samples taken on one day at the site; each primer set is a separate amplification and sequencing of the sample's extract); period = the sequenced (midsummer) bout, one a year per site, indexed globally by date
geographicCoverage: 7 NEON lakes in the United States (contiguous states, Alaska, Puerto Rico); coordinates of the most recent sample's named location in __units (WGS 84); latitude 29.6 to 68.7, longitude -149.6 to -82.0

coordinatesCoarsened.method: coarsen_coords(): NEON's published coordinates in __units snapped to their 0.1-degree cell centre, uncertainty the cell half-diagonal, elevation rounded to 100 m, because names IUCN CR/EN/VU in their native range are in the table (Skistodiaptomus carolinensis (VU, at BARC); E7, ruling on the publisher 2026-11-06). NEON site codes are kept. neon_2026_zooplankton_dna_exact_occ keeps the other names at published precision.

covariateNote: obs_genetic_sample_id = NEON geneticSampleID (the morphological sampleID + '.DNA': join to the morphological product of the same sample); obs_marker = COI primer set (BE or F230); obs_reads_total and obs_reads_filtered = the sample x primer set's reads (sampleTotalReadNumber) and reads after quality filtering (sampleFilteredReadNumber) on the sequencing run its taxonomy comes from: the sequencing depth; obs_n_variants = the name's reported sequence variants in the survey (0 where y = 0); obs_max_pct_match = the highest percentSequenceMatch among them (NA where y = 0 or not reported), to apply a stricter identity threshold than the laboratory's; obs_lab = laboratory; obs_low_extraction_efficiency = 1 where NEON's dataQF reads 'low extraction efficiency' (every 2022 Laragen sample: an extraction that favoured bacterial DNA), else 0; obs_sampler_type, obs_tows (tows or traps composited), obs_volume_l (litres sampled) of the field sample.
notes: Metabarcoding ruling (Ben, 2026-11-13; standard E9): detection, reads in y_raw, depth as obs_ columns; the read count is not abundance. NEON's reporting threshold is the laboratory's: a variant is reported only after denoising and filtering (smallest reported read count Jonah Ventures 8, Laragen 6). Names are the laboratory's assignments at whatever identity it reported (obs_max_pct_match ships it): 187 species names, 144 interim names (BOLD BINs and voucher labels, species-rank, no taxonID), 153 at a higher rank. PCR replicates are not separable in the taxonomy table (reads are reported per extract x primer set), so they are not occasions; the 2022 sequencing records listed under replicates 1 and 2 are identical. Per-site pools (ruling 19): median 106 names (range 80-172). 3 extract(s) NEON marks extraction qaqc Fail are kept, since the laboratory reported taxonomy for them. The morphological counts of the companion samples are neon_2026_zooplankton_count. 7 sites: below the sample floor of 30 units.

notShipped.unassigned sequence variants: 3,256 variant rows (1,216,045 reads) the laboratory did not name; their reads are in the depth columns, not in any row
notShipped.samples not sequenced: 213 field DNA samples with no extract in the release (bouts 1 and 3 are archived at the NEON Biorepository, not sequenced)
notShipped.surveys not used: 12 extract x primer sets of the 2017 pilot sequenced (four PCR replicates) with no taxonomy rows; 1 with no taxonomy rows after failed sequencing; 1 whose taxonomy comes from a sequencing record NEON marks Fail (fewer than 3,000 reads)
notShipped.sequences and raw data: taxonSequence (the variant's sequence), sequenceName, raw sequence files (expanded package links), the standard (mock community) samples, inv_metabarcodeTaxonList and inv_metabarcodeSummary
notShipped.zeros outside the site pool: a name never assigned at a site has no rows there (per-site pool)
